text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Dear Trainer, with the year drawing to 
a close, how have you been doing?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we see each other almost 
every day, mind you――"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I feel as though I can convey my feelings 
better in writing. With that thought in 
mind, I take up my pen. Right now, I—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: “It feels... like a dream.”
Heeey, what are you writing out here?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, wha... C.B.-san?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo. Sorry, sorry, did I startle you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Mr. C.B.-san... A Triple Tiara Umamusume 
blessed with absurd talent. Why is someone 
like her here...?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf was looking for you earlier. Why 
not go see her whenever you feel like it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? Th-Thank you very much. You went 
out of your way to look for me...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Just a coincidence. I came up to the 
roof for a nap, and you happened to be 
here.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is... is that so...!? I'm so sorry for 
misunderstanding...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm heading to the student 
council room, so...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You really don't need to apologize so 
much... Ah, there she goes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looking at her like this, she seems 
rather reserved, or rather... she doesn't 
have any drive in her at all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—And yet, she's 'like that' on the turf... 
She really is an interesting girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm Zenno Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Enter.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: E-Excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Symboli Rudolf-san and Narita 
Brian-san... Two Triple Crown Umamusume! 
The pressure is insane...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...? U-Um, did I... do something...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No, sorry for calling you out so 
suddenly. I'm sure Chairwoman Akikawa has 
already spoken to you, but I wanted to 
offer my congratulations as well."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The Classic Triple Crown, the Spring 
Senior Triple Crown, and the Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Crowned with nine titles, a hero among 
heroes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Magnificent. I feel truly honored to 
exist in the same era as you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah, u-um...! Th-thank... you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, I have a favor to ask. 
You see, Brian here—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Cut the chatter. Are you free right now?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eep!? U-Um... I don't really have any 
plans, but...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then come to the training track. I have it 
reserved for today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The running of this so-called 
unprecedented grand hero— let me see it up 
close. I'll tear it to shreds.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ha—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hai-ee... huh?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(T-Things have gotten totally out of 
hand...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(T-To think I'm running alongside 
Brian-san... Is she gonna chew me up and 
spit me out...!?)
—Oh? Why the long face, buddy?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-This graceful yet commanding voice is—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Just as you suspected, it's me!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O-san... Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Overlord is naturally flawless and 
elusive, after all! And besides—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Why is this guy here too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I was drawn to tales of heroes. 
'Ei! Let's go!' and all that... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
......Very well. A chaotic race has its 
own charm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you smirking over there, too! You're 
not planning to skip out on this feast, 
are you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so you caught on after all. Well, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind this kind of crazy mess. 
Above all, it looks like a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wah... u-um, errr...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you really sure... that you all want 
someone like me to...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Foolish question.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"You had already stepped onto the same 
stage as us long ago... And yet, you 
weren't satisfied with just that—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, hero! Do you point your blade even 
higher, beyond the dream itself?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Beyond the dream...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Just for this moment today, the 
stage is yours. Give it everything you've 
got."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course—this magnificent Overlord just 
might flip the entire stage upside down, 
though!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... I'm still dreaming, or 
maybe like all of this is a dream.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Still, everyone's—searing fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It tells me that this is reality, that 
this is what lies beyond the dream. That 
is why—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Hero', Zenno Rob Roy— shall be 
your opponent...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! A whole lineup of star Umamusume! 
Just watching gets me all excited.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Me too...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I'll become one too. An 
Umamusume whose sparkle can light up 
everyone's hearts like that!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, right now, I feel like I'm in a 
dream."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"But... because you were there with me. 
Because you didn't let my dream just 
remain a dream—"

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: On your mark—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: “Right now, I'm beyond my dream.”
